program.name: Backbend Flexibility
program.subject: Flexibility
program.blurb: Flexibility for backbends: the front of the hips, the spine and the shoulders, opened slowly.
program.about: Flexibility for backbends, built from the places that limit them. One day opens the front of the hips and the spine with lunges, sphinx and camel; the other opens the shoulders and chest with puppy, thread-the-needle and chest openers. Every stretch is held on the clock and the voice walks you through. Levels II and III hold a little longer.
